what: Sources for the route criterion of round 53 (captive_bands_r53.py LANDLOCKED and LNG_FROM). No data was downloaded this round; the volume and share data are round 48's committed extracts (raw/demand_cf_r48).

sources.name: UN-OHRLLS, List of Landlocked Developing Countries (32 countries)
sources.used_for: LANDLOCKED (ARM, AZE, KAZ, KGZ, MDA, MNG, MKD, TJK, TKM, UZB, AFG and others)

sources.name: Landlocked European countries (geography): Austria, Belarus, Czechia, Hungary, Slovakia, Serbia, Switzerland, Liechtenstein, Luxembourg, Andorra, San Marino, Vatican, Kosovo
GIIGNL Annual Report (LNG import terminals by country and start-up year)
sources.used_for: LNG_FROM: Lithuania Klaipeda FSRU Dec 2014 (2014), Poland Swinoujscie (first commercial 2016), Croatia Krk (Jan 2021), Malta Delimara (2017), Netherlands Gate (2011), Finland Inkoo FSRU and Hamina (2022; Pori 2016 and Tornio 2018 are small off-grid terminals, not counted), Estonia Paldiski (2022), Germany (Wilhelmshaven, Dec 2022)

limits: The route criterion is a physical-entry rule for the country itself. It does not count pipeline interconnectors that could have carried non-Russian gas (Balticconnector 2020, Iasi-Ungheni 2014, Hungary-Austria HAG, reverse flows into Slovakia and Czechia, the Iran-Armenia pipeline) or crude by other pipelines (Adria to Hungary and Slovakia, IKL/TAL to Czechia). The share criterion (Russia >= 70% of the product's imports) is what tests whether such alternatives were actually used.
